content: Our final model achieves an out-of-sample correlation of 57% between predicted and observed illusionabilites. Here, the observed illusionability of the words is calculated as the difference between the accuracy of watchers of the illusory videos and the accuracy of listeners, where “accuracy” is defined as the fraction of respondents who were correct. For each word, the predicted illusionability is calculated from doing inference on that word using the averaged regression coefficients of the regression trials where the word is not in the training set.
